ttkDefinition: Ideal chest TTK is measured from the first damaging chest hit to the lethal chest hit against 100 HP. A one-shot chest kill is represented as 0 ms / 1 SHOT. ADS time, reaction time, network latency and projectile flight time are excluded. Bolt-action follow-up timing uses independently verified effective shot-to-shot cadence rather than blindly trusting the upstream raw RPM field.
notes: All six current sniper rifles are audited at every integer meter from 1m through 300m.
M2010 ESR, SV-98, PSR and L115 use the current EA 1.3.3 sweet-spot windows and linear game-file damage curves.

Mini Scout has no sweet spot. Its current game-file damage curve is 62 damage through 21m, linearly falling to 58 at 75m and remaining at 58 beyond. Its effective follow-up interval includes the official 1.1.3.0 +100ms minimum time between shots, producing about 47 RPM effective cadence.

Interdictor is missing from the upstream analyzer as of this audit. It is modeled from current live field evidence: 31 RPM, 732m/s, 150 maximum damage, guaranteed all-body one-shot window 120-150m, and observed chest one-shot window 106-164m. Its transition curve is marked empirical-current until a current game-file curve is published.
Recon sniper proficiency is known to improve rechambering, but no verified numeric multiplier is applied here. This audit is class-neutral and will not guess a class-specific TTK bonus.

DLC Bolt / straight-pull behavior can preserve the sight picture while cycling; it is utility, not a verified reduction of the actual shot-to-shot interval, so it does not change this theoretical TTK.
No sniper attachment or ammo may alter chest damage, effective shot interval or fire mode in VERIFIED META unless that transform is explicitly audited.
